## Round 2 repairs

- Jointly fitted three views using photo-measured drawer motion and compartment constraints.
- Replaced the washed-out satin approximation with a polished anisotropic steel material and source-colour reflection environment.
- Added the observed neck-mark photo crop and shallow molded end ribs; no unreadable lettering was invented.

## Physics and contacts

Canonical envelope [0.038561, 0.122884, 0.007932] m; dry mass estimate 0.01126 kg; material density 7900 kg/m³; friction 0.35; restitution 0.12. See model.json for material components, inertia, COM, uncertainty and deformable fallback parameters. Product mass is not measured. There are 74 closed convex pieces; contact margin 0.0001 m. Container membership is not a weld or rigid articulation.

## Remaining limits

- Exact product identity, weighed mass and measured friction remain unavailable; density-derived masses and contact coefficients are explicit priors.
- Illumination is approximate. Photo histograms and source-colour reflection maps are not calibrated albedo or HDR radiance measurements.

## Rebuild

Run Blender with `-b -P build.py`; the shared generator reads `../assets.json`, `../build_common.py` and `../qa_geometry.py`. OBJ coordinates are canonical metres, +Z up. GLB is glTF +Y up; Blender dynamic origins are at COM. Repeat the calibrated render, collision and metadata checks after rebuilding; old QA grades must not be assumed valid after edits.
